title: Postulates (part 1)
textbookText: 1. All gases are composed of a large number of perfectly small elastic spheres called molecules. 2. The attraction between gas molecules is negligible. 3. The volume of a molecule is negligible as compared to the total volume occupied by the
gas. 4. The duration of a collision is negligible compared with the time between the collisions.
The pressure exerted by the gas is the force imparted by its molecules per unit area of the wall of the container during collisions.
